name: keystore.purge
title: Delete stored secrets by scope
summary: Not in the original brief, and required by the data-split contract: when a subscription or server disappears on the Connector side, its credentials must be deletable without deleting user intent, and the user must be able to wipe every secret while keeping profiles. A keystore that can only be reset by reinstalling the Connector is not a keystore.

scope.description: 'orphaned' = secrets no remaining entity references. This is the safe default a UI can offer without a destructive-sounding label.

ids.description: Required for scope server, subscription and profile; ignored for orphaned and all.

confirmToken.description: Proof of an explicit user action. 'all' additionally requires the token to be issued in the same session as the call.

invariants: Purging a secret a live profile still references returns retained=[...] with reason 'still-referenced'; the Connector refuses to make an applied config unresolvable.
